"""URL slugs."""

import re
import unicodedata


def slugify(title):
    """Lowercase ASCII slug: accents folded to base letters, words joined by single hyphens."""
    s = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title.lower())
    # Drop combining marks left by decomposition (e.g. the accent in "è" -> "e" + U+0300).
    s = "".join(c for c in s if not unicodedata.combining(c))
    s = s.encode("ascii", "ignore").decode("ascii")
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", s)
    return s.strip("-")

"""Text truncation for previews."""


def truncate(text, limit, hard_cut=False):
    """Shorten text to at most `limit` characters, adding "...".

    By default cuts at the last whole word that fits (the "..." counts toward
    the limit). If no whole word fits, falls back to a hard cut.

    `hard_cut=True` keeps the legacy behaviour: exactly `limit` characters
    (mobile previews rely on this).
    """
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    keep = limit - 3
    if keep <= 0:
        return "..."[:limit]
    if hard_cut:
        return text[:keep] + "..."
    # If the character right after the window is whitespace, the window ends on a word boundary.
    if text[keep].isspace():
        head = text[:keep]
    else:
        idx = max(text.rfind(c, 0, keep) for c in " \t\n\r")
        if idx <= 0:
            # No whole word fits (single overlong word): hard cut.
            return text[:keep] + "..."
        head = text[:idx]
    return head.rstrip() + "..."
